Golden sandbox architecture notes.

The ADR blocks below exist to give `adr-check` real records to assess. Each one
targets a different branch of assessAdrRecords: harness capability, catalog check
id, fitness rule id, phantom reference, retired record, manual-only.

### ADR-001: Modules never import across a forbidden edge
Status: accepted
Enforced-by: arch-check

### ADR-002: Every module carries a passing baseline check
Status: accepted
Enforced-by: always-pass

### ADR-003: No credential literal reaches the repository
Status: accepted
Enforced-by: no-secret-literal

### ADR-004: Request identifiers stay stable across retries
Status: accepted
Enforced-by: the team keeps an eye on it

### ADR-005: Sessions were stored in a shared cache
Status: superseded
Enforced-by: replaced by ADR-001

### ADR-006: Public endpoints stay backward compatible
Status: accepted
Enforced-by: manual review before release
